import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either `heading` or `description` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise ValueError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(description, str): raise ValueError("description must be a string") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent XSS. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized content into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description)
